title: Optimize Discord
name: optimize-discord
description: Stops Discord from stealing FPS: lowers its CPU priority, sends it to the integrated GPU and clears its caches to free RAM.
deepDescription:
Discord keeps a Chromium renderer, the overlay and the voice engine running, which eats RAM and competes with your game for CPU and GPU time. This tweak:

- Sets every **Discord.exe** process to **BelowNormal** priority so the game always wins the CPU.
- Routes Discord to the **integrated GPU** (GpuPreference=1), keeping the dedicated GPU free for the game.
- Disables Discord **hardware acceleration** (backed up first, restored on revert) to reduce GPU contention.
- Clears Discord's **Cache**, **Code Cache**, **GPUCache**, **Service Worker** and **blob_storage** folders.

Fully reversible — the original settings file is backed up before any change.
